decisions.reason: Its move from a simple mention to its own page is a positive market signal, and as a low-cost complement to the core flooring business it remains an attractive option to develop further.

After two selling periods it shows no stronger market validation than an initial mention and overlaps with the better-signalled wood-care line, so the option value now looks limited relative to keeping it active.
Its promotion on a dedicated page suggests meaningful customer traction, and it strengthens the firm's aftercare system around oiled wood floors at relatively low continuation cost.
As a close complementary product for installation, it is inexpensive to keep on the market and the available evidence is still too limited to justify abandonment in a growing flooring business.

It has not advanced beyond a basic mention, appears more commodity-like and duplicative within the underlay category, and releasing resources is preferable when the option has shown little distinct value.

A new parquet variant is costlier to carry than care or accessory products, and with only weak market signalling after launch the firm should redeploy capacity toward stronger core lines and newer options.
